title: UneceProductBatchCertificate
description:
A piece of written, printed or electronic matter that provides information or evidence that a product batch has met
required criteria.

actualEffectiveDateTime.description: The actual effective date, time, date time or other date time value for this product batch certificate.

applicableAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion applicable to this product batch certificate.

applicableObjectCode.description: A code specifying an object for which this product batch certificate is applicable.

applicableProductCharacteristic.description: A product characteristic applicable to this product batch certificate.

applicableStandard.description: A referenced standard applicable to this product batch certificate.

applicableSustainabilityCharacteristic.description: A sustainability characteristic applicable to this product batch certificate.

applicableTradeProductCertification.description: The trade product certification applicable to this product batch certificate.

attachedBinaryFile.description: A binary file attached to this product batch certificate.

certificateTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of product batch certificate.

description.description: A textual description of this product batch certificate.

expiryDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value when this product batch certificate expires.

identifier.description: The identifier of this product batch certificate.

issueDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value when this product batch certificate was issued.

issueReasonCode.description: The code specifying the reason why this product batch certificate was issued.

issuingPartyId.description: The identifier of the party issuing this product batch certificate.

purposeCode.description: A code specifying a purpose of this product batch certificate.

requestedEffectiveDateTime.description: The requested effective date, time, date time or other date time value for this product batch certificate.
